name: Cut-out figure in front of a giant wordmark
description: A flat colour ground (one saturated or near-black tone, optional static noise at 4%), 100svh. A giant wordmark in live display type spans 94% of the width (36px side margins), 155-220px tall, its top about 90px from the screen top. In front of it, covering the lower half of the letters, a cut-out figure or character close-up (transparent render, 65-75% of the screen height) anchored bottom-right at about 55% of the width. Bottom-left one short three-line blurb of 18px (max 260px wide); across the top row two or three filled link pills (40px high); at the bottom a control row of two 48px filled circle buttons. Pointer parallax: wordmark 8px, figure 24px the other way. Colour roles: ground flat; ink white or black; accent = the wordmark fill or the figure's key colour.
phone: Wordmark fitted to 92% of the width at the top (one or two lines); figure 70% of the width bottom-centre overlapping it; one blurb under the wordmark; pills in one top row; the control row hidden.
houseRuleCheck: All small type 16px or larger in sentence case; the wordmark keeps 36px side margins. Built as a layered cut-out; no live 3D needed.

name: 3D figure scene, bottom-left text stack
description: A fixed full-screen canvas scene, 100svh, on a flat dark ground: one central figure or sculpture (a character, a letterform built from particles, a product model) about 55-65% of the screen height, centred slightly right of middle. At bottom-left, 48-64px from the sides and 56px from the bottom, a white text stack of 3-4 lines at 40-96px, leading 0.95, the first line the largest; each line set whole in one face (a condensed or a regular, not mixed inside a line). A small tagline of 18-20px (max 280px wide) bottom-right or above the stack. Minimal nav on top. Pinned for 150-250vh: scroll orbits the camera 30-60 degrees and shifts the scene between two flat tones while the text stays. Colour roles: ground one dark flat tone; ink white; accent = the scene's key light colour.
phone: Figure at 55% of the height in the upper part; text stack at the bottom, 36-56px in two or three lines; tagline below it; camera orbit driven by scroll over 150vh.
houseRuleCheck: One face per line, never a picked-out word. Needs a 3D model or a looping render of the figure.

name: Central object, content in four quadrants
description: A full-bleed top-down scene of a real tabletop or a flat colour surface, 100svh, with one object dead centre (about 30% of the height). Content sits in the four quadrants around it, all 48px in from the edges: top-left a heavy wordmark of 64-80px with a one-line 18px tagline under it; top-right two or three 18px links; right of centre a three-line paragraph of 24px (max 320px wide); bottom-left a short block of a 28px line and a 16px line; bottom-right one filled pill (56px high) with the main action. All of it is plain text or filled buttons; no card or tile over the scene. Scroll rotates the object 90 degrees while the items drift 12px in opposing directions. Colour roles: ground = the surface; ink black or white; accent = the pill and link hover colour.
phone: Object top-centre at 40% of the height; wordmark above it, the paragraph and short block stacked below in three rows; the pill full width at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: No translucent card, video tile, edge tab or bar over the scene; small type 16px or larger in sentence case; everything 48px inside the edges; five text items at most.

name: 3D wordmark over a short statement
description: White (or very pale tint) ground, 100svh, transparent 72px nav. A flat black 3D wordmark about 900x225px (live 3D lettering that tilts 6-10 degrees toward the pointer with easing) centred about 96px below the nav. Starting 60px under it, a statement of 72-89px, leading 1.02, near-black, centred or left aligned within about 1200px, three lines at most, ending inside the first screen with 56px of ground below it, plus one filled pill (56px high) beside or under it. Nothing else. On scroll the wordmark rotates to 25 degrees and shrinks while the statement fades out line by line. Colour roles: ground white or pale tint, ink near-black, accent = the pill.
phone: Wordmark fitted to 86% of the width (about 80px tall); statement 34-42px in up to four lines; full-width pill; the pointer tilt becomes a slow auto-sway.
houseRuleCheck: The statement is three lines at most and ends inside the first screen; no small tag above, no numbers. The wordmark is live 3D lettering, not a drawn graphic.

name: Video tile beside action tile
description: One flat ground tone, 100svh. A three-column grid in a 1392px container (24px side margins) with 20px gutters, starting 88px from the top under the nav and ending 24px above the bottom edge, so it fills the screen height and nothing of the next section shows. The left tile spans two columns: a video (radius 24) with a caption bottom-left (a headline of 40-48px in up to two lines, white, 32px in) and a 48px filled pause circle bottom-right. The right tile is one column of a flat accent fill (radius 24), as tall as the grid: at the top a big action label of 48-56px (two or three words, ink on the accent) beside a 56px filled arrow chip; at the foot three small filled option chips (40px high, a slightly darker tone of the accent). Hover: the action tile lifts 8px and the arrow chip turns 45 degrees; the video scales 1.04 inside its tile. Colour roles: ground flat; video = the media; action tile = accent; ink on the accent chosen for contrast.
phone: Tiles stack: the video tile at 60% of the screen height, the action tile below with its chips in one row; 16px margins and gutters.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the caption and no rule in the action tile; the options are filled chips. The grid fills the screen so nothing of the next section shows.

name: Bottom portrait row under an empty field
description: One screen, 100svh, on a flat pale or deep ground. Nav items sit on the same 12-column grid as the tiles. The upper two thirds is a wide field of plain ground holding only one 2-line headline of 88-120px on the first column (or a wordmark of that size) and a filled pill (56px high) at the right. Anchored to the bottom, 24px above the edge, a row of five portrait tiles (ratio 4:5, about 270px wide at 1440, 8px gaps, radius 0 or 16), each with an 18px sentence-case caption (a name or a title) directly under it. Hover: the hovered tile widens (flex-grow 1 to 1.7) while the others narrow, its picture scales 1.05 and its caption turns accent. Entry: the tiles rise 60px in an 80ms stagger. Colour roles: ground flat; ink strongly contrasting; accent = hover caption and the pill.
phone: Headline 40-52px top-left; below it a 2x2 grid of four tiles (the fifth dropped) fills the rest of the screen with 8px gaps and captions under each; no hover widening.
houseRuleCheck: A fixed row of five that fits the width, never an endless or dragged row; captions 18px sentence case; 24px margin to every edge. Portraits are styled fashion, lifestyle or product shots, never documentary.

name: Small 3D object over sentence and pill
description: White or very pale canvas, 100svh. An opening beat of about 2s: ribbons or particles in one accent hue rush past the camera and settle into a small resting 3D object (thin rings, a bottle, a knot; about 320px wide) just above the middle. Under it, centred, a two-line sentence of 22-26px (max 520px wide, ink) and a filled pill 56px high 28px below. Bottom-left one 18px text link; bottom-right a short 18px note and a 48px filled circle sound button. No display headline. The object turns slowly and tilts toward the pointer; on scroll it scales to 2x while the sentence fades. Colour roles: ground white, ink near-black, accent = the ribbons, the object and the pill (a single hue).
phone: Object 60% of the width above centre; sentence 20px; full-width pill; note and sound circle share the bottom row; the opening rush shortened to 1s.
houseRuleCheck: Small copy 18px sentence case; the pill is filled. One hue for ribbons, object and pill. Needs a 3D model or transparent renders of the object.

name: Centred headline, art rising from the fold
description: One 100svh stage on one flat ground (a saturated brand colour, a pale tint or near-black). Headline centred in the upper half: 100-140px at 1440, 2-3 lines, leading 0.95, max 1100px wide, top about 130px from the screen top; an optional one-line sub of 22px sits 24px under it. One large artwork, a product cut-out or render (transparent webp), 480-800px wide, centred and anchored to the bottom edge, standing up from it so that 30-40% of its height is cut by the fold; it sits on the bare ground. Two 48px filled circle arrow buttons may flank it at 25% and 75% of the width to switch product or colour. On scroll the headline scales to 70% and drifts up while the art scales to 125% and rises; hovering an arrow tilts the art 4 degrees. Colour roles: ground flat; ink contrasting; accent only on the arrows or one button.
phone: Headline 44-56px in three lines; art 85% of the width, cropped by the bottom edge; the arrows become small circles either side under the headline.
houseRuleCheck: The art is a photographed or rendered cut-out of the real product on bare ground: no colour disc behind it, no drawn picture, no side rules.

name: Headline then wide media that grows
description: Solid ground (a pale tint, a deep colour or white), 100svh, under a 72px nav. Centred version: a one- or two-line display headline, 64-120px at 1440, leading 0.98, max 1000px wide, starting about 120px below the top; no sub. 56-72px below it one wide media block (video, or a still of the product in use): 1392px wide with 24px side margins, radius 32, top edge at about 44-50% of the screen height, bottom edge 24px above the fold, so the whole composition ends inside the first screen with plain ground below it. Diagonal version: a 120px two-line upper-case heavy headline (leading 0.92) top-left across about half the width, a 30px two-line sub lower in the right-hand columns below the headline's baseline, a small filled round scroll button under the headline, and the media block from about y 470 (1336x380, radius 24, 52px margins, 40px above the bottom). On scroll the block pins and grows to full bleed (margins and radius go to 0) over 60-100vh while the type slides up and out. Colour roles: ground one flat colour; ink strongly contrasting; accent only on one filled pill in the nav or the scroll button.
phone: Headline 40-52px in up to three lines (the diagonal sub 18px under it); media block 4:5 or 1:1 with 16px margins filling the rest of the first screen; the same grow-to-full-bleed on a 60vh pin.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the headline. The media block ends inside the first screen with ground below it, never cropped by the fold, so nothing of the next section shows.

name: Centred picture-and-text pair with category chips
description: Exactly one screen (100svh) on a white or very pale ground. A centred group about 850px wide, vertically centred in the space above the chip row: a picture on the left (a product shot, a render or a photograph, about 350px, radius 24) and a 420px text column on the right, 32px gap: a headline of 32-40px in three lines, then two full-width buttons stacked 12px apart, 56px high, the first filled accent, the second filled in a pale tint of the ground. Along the bottom, 64px up, a centred static row of 6-9 category chips (40px high, radius 20, soft tint fill, 18px text, 12px gaps) that wraps to a second row on narrow screens. Hover: chips lift 4px and fill darker; the picture eases 1.03. Colour roles: ground white, ink near-black, accent = the first button.
phone: The group stacks (picture 16:10 on top, headline 28px, both buttons full width); the chips become a two-row wrap at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The picture is a product shot, a render or a photograph, never a drawn picture; no rule, no carousel chevrons, no shadow; the second button is a pale fill, never an outline. Best for utility-led sites.

name: Centred title over full-bleed scene
description: One 100svh stage. The backdrop is a looping video or a live canvas scene, cover fit; if it is bright, lay a single flat ink layer at 25-40% over it, never a gradient. Transparent nav on top, 72px tall, 24px side padding. The title is centred on both axes (optical middle at about 46% of the height), one or two lines, 96-160px at 1440, leading 0.92-1.0, tracking -0.02em, one colour, max 1100px wide. 24-32px under it a sub of 20-24px, max 44 characters per line, 70% opacity. Optionally one filled pill (56px high, 32px side padding) 32px under the sub, and a small scroll cue bottom centre, 40px up (a 16px sentence-case word plus a small arrow). Nothing else on the screen. When the scene is an explorable room or interior, the title may be two whole lines in two contrasting faces (a high-contrast serif line over a clean sans line, 100-118px, overlapping by 10-14% of their height), with two 48px filled round controls in the bottom corners, 32px in, that step between views or toggle sound, each with a 16px sentence-case label; the scene then drifts 2-4 degrees on its own and answers the pointer with 20px of parallax. Motion: title lines rise out of masks 80ms apart (0.9s, ease-out-expo); on scroll the backdrop scales 1.0 to 1.08 while the title fades and lifts over the first 40% of the screen height. Colour roles: ground = the backdrop; ink = white on dark footage or near-black on light; accent = the button fill only.
phone: Same stack centred on a portrait crop or poster frame; title 44-64px in up to four short lines; sub 17px; button full width minus a 32px gutter, 56px high, 32px above the safe area; corner controls become one centred row of 48px circles at the bottom; slow auto-drift of the camera instead of pointer parallax; video pauses under reduced motion or data saver.
houseRuleCheck: The backdrop is footage, a live canvas or a photograph, never a gradient stage; darken it only with one flat ink layer. No label above the title and no partner logos. With two faces each line stays whole, never one picked-out word.

name: Centred wordmark over full-screen picture, text at the edges
description: A full-screen looping video, or a still photograph moved by a slow liquid-displacement shader that the pointer ripples, 100svh; no overlay except an optional flat 20% ink layer; no nav chrome beyond one menu text button top-right, 40px in. A serif wordmark 500-660px wide dead centre (white, live type or the supplied logo, leading 1). Bottom-left, 56px from the left and from the bottom: a 40px serif title (up to two lines, max 520px) with an 18px text link beside or under it that grows an underline from the left on hover. Bottom-right, at the same inset: a three-line paragraph of 18px (max 340px wide). Nothing else. Variant: instead of the corner blocks, flank the wordmark with a three-line 20px caption right-aligned to its left and a mirrored one left-aligned to its right, on its centre line with 56px gaps, and run a bottom row 28px from the edges with social text links left, the local time centre and one filled button right; the caption lines rise through masks on load. Over the first 30vh of scroll the wordmark fades to 0 and the text blocks lift away while the picture dims 40%. Colour roles: ground = the footage or photograph; ink white; accent none, or the one button.
phone: Wordmark 70-80% of the width, centred; title and link stacked bottom-left with a 24px gutter (or the two captions beneath the wordmark in two columns); the paragraph hidden or cut to one line; any button full width at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Text blocks keep a 56px inset (28px for the bottom row); the paragraph is three lines at most. No rule or box in the bottom row; the button is filled. The navigation is links only, no sentence.

name: Colour-block collage, crossing headline
description: 100svh cut into three hard flat colour blocks from one hue family: a block top-left (about 62% wide, 55% tall), a block bottom-left (62% wide, the remaining height) and one block on the right (38% wide, full height); a slim static side column (72px) at the left holds the logo and a menu button. Across all blocks a two-line headline of 150-175px, leading 0.9, set bottom-left so its words cross the block edges. The headline is drawn three times, each copy clipped to one block and set in that block's contrasting ink (all from the palette), so letters change colour exactly where a block edge cuts them. No picture, no discs, no gradient. The pointer shifts the block boundaries by up to 4% (smooth resize); on scroll the blocks slide out in a 120ms stagger. Colour roles: three flat tones of one family (a deep, a bright, a pale) plus ink; no fourth colour.
phone: Blocks re-cut into three full-width horizontal bands; headline 56-72px at the bottom crossing the band edges with the same clipped copies; the side column becomes a top bar with logo and menu.
houseRuleCheck: Three flat tones of one hue family plus ink, no fourth colour, no blended discs, no gradient. The side column is static.

name: Mono-colour video with mosaic band
description: A single-colour graded video (a portrait or face shot, desaturated and tinted to one hue with a flat colour-blend layer, no gradient) fills the first screen, 100svh. Over the eyes of the subject a band of coarse mosaic blocks about 750x240px (cells of 24-32px, a canvas pixelate of the video itself) hides them. Bottom-left, 48px in: one 18px line of three plain words (a place, a year, a role), under it a 72px condensed serif wordmark, then a second wide line of 24px ending in an arrow glyph. Nav row on top (logo left, three 18px links right). On scroll the clip changes: each of three clips has its own single tint and the change dissolves through a 400ms mosaic of the whole frame. Colour roles: ground = the tinted video (one hue per clip); ink white; accent none.
phone: Mosaic band scales to 90% of the width (about 160px tall) over the face; the plain line and a 44px wordmark at the bottom; second line 18px; nav collapses to a menu word.
houseRuleCheck: Footage of a styled subject (a model or performer), never documentary. The three-word line is plain type: no tag, chip or outline over the video.

name: Corner title over 3D canvas
description: A black screen exactly 100svh with a full-bleed canvas scene (3D or a generative particle field); at most one flat 30% black layer over the top 30% if the nav needs it, no gradient. Top-left a short paragraph of 16-18px sans (max 280px, white at 70%); nav items of 18px in the top corners. A two-line upper-case display title of 160-180px, white, leading 0.88, flush to the right and set 48px in from the right and bottom edges, tilted by CSS perspective (rotateY -12 degrees, rotateX 4 degrees) so it recedes to the right. On scroll the title straightens to 0 degrees while the camera moves forward. Colour roles: ground black, ink white, accent = the canvas's one key colour.
phone: Title 56-72px in two lines at the bottom-right with a 24px inset, tilt reduced to 6 degrees; paragraph top-left at 15px; nav becomes a menu word top-right.
houseRuleCheck: The title sits 48px inside the right and bottom edges; no dark fade over the top, only a flat layer if needed; the paragraph is the page's sans, never small code type.

name: Depth cloud of image planes
description: Off-white ground (a warm or cool pale tone), 100svh. 18-26 image planes scattered across the screen at varied depth (CSS 3D with perspective 1200px, or WebGL): near planes large (220-340px wide), sharp and opaque; far planes small (80-140px), blurred 2px at 40% opacity; some images sit on flat pale tiles of one warm or cool hue family (two tones at most). A clear zone of about 760x280px in the centre holds a 72px two-line headline, near-black, centred, so no text sits on a picture. Optional opening: the planes first gather as one wavy ribbon of stacked cards at the centre (about 660x320, rotated in depth along a sine wave), rest for a second, then burst outward into the cloud as the headline fades up. Each plane drifts on its own 12-20s loop (10-30px) and shifts with the pointer by depth. Pinned for 120vh: scroll drifts the planes upward at depth-based speeds and the first photo scales up and wipes over the screen as the transition into the next section. Colour roles: ground off-white, ink near-black, accent = the pale tiles.
phone: 10-12 planes at 60% scale around a clear centre (a 16-card ribbon at half amplitude for the opening); headline 40px; slow auto-drift instead of pointer shift; same wipe transition.
houseRuleCheck: Styled or product pictures, never documentary or archive; no plane gets a card; tiles stay flat and pale, never in the violet family; no text on a picture, and no picture between the words of the headline.

name: Phone mockup over ghost headline
description: A dark stage (near-black with a 4% static grain), 100svh. A phone mockup about 740px tall (CSS-built: 10px bezel, radius 56, flat dark ink) rises from y=135 past the bottom edge so its lower third is cut by the fold; its screen plays about 10 seconds of the real product UI. A centred headline of 72px (white, three lines, leading 1.0) and a one-line 20px sub lie over the lower part of the mockup, kept readable by one flat ink layer at 55% over the screen (no gradient). Behind everything the same headline repeats as a 120px echo across the top at 12% opacity, blurred 6px, with a second copy offset 6px in the accent colour. Pinned 150vh: scroll lifts the mockup by 120px and fades the echo. Colour roles: ground near-black, ink white, accent = the offset echo and one button.
phone: Mockup 78% of the width rising from mid-screen; headline 40px over its lower part; echo hidden.
houseRuleCheck: No labels around the phone; type inside the screen is the real product UI at 14px or more. The echo is blurred type, not a shadow; one accent.

name: Colour field, spinning badge, tilted pill
description: One flat saturated colour field (not violet) filling 100svh; the hero itself holds still on scroll. A two-line wordmark of 140px at top centre (heavy grotesque or condensed display, leading 0.88, near-black or cream) with one 18px text link at each side on the same baseline. A round badge about 180px at the upper right, 48px in, turning slowly (20s per turn): a flat disc in a second tone with ring text of 16px sentence case set on a circular path and a small photo or the brand mark at its centre. One dark pill tilted -5 degrees at bottom centre, 64px high and 220-280px wide, with a 28px label in the field colour; on hover it straightens to 0 degrees and scales 1.06. Colour roles: ground flat saturated; ink near-black; accent = the badge disc (one second tone).
phone: Wordmark 64-80px, links collapse to a menu word, badge 110px under the wordmark at the right, pill full width minus 48px at the bottom keeping its tilt.
houseRuleCheck: The badge is a flat disc with live ring text in sentence case, never tiny tracked capitals or a drawn emblem. Two colours plus ink, the ground never in the violet family.

name: Inset canvas with tilted device, scrubbed
description: A coloured page frame (one flat tone) with a canvas inset 18px (radius 24) filling 100svh. Inside, a tilted device (a laptop, phone or product object, 40-50% of the height) stands in a staged 3D scene; a 60px two-line headline in white and a one-line 20px sub top-left, 40px in; top-right a filled nav pill (logo chip and menu); bottom-left a 56px filled round play button for the film; bottom-right one filled pill (48px high) with the main action. Pinned for 200vh: scroll scrubs the scene's lighting between two flat tones while the camera dollies in 15%, and at the end the frame's inset and radius animate to 0 so the canvas dissolves into the next section's ground. Colour roles: frame = brand tone; scene = two lighting tones; ink white; accent = the pills.
phone: Frame 10px; headline 36px top-left; device at 60% of the width, centred; the two controls become 48px circles in the bottom corners; scroll length 150vh.
houseRuleCheck: Lighting changes as flat tone shifts, never a gradient; no popover or card over the scene.

name: Full-width wordmark over image, shrinking
description: Flat colour ground (one saturated or pale tone), 100svh. A thin nav of three or four filled colour-block tabs (44px high). A one-word extra-bold wordmark in live type spans the 1392px container (24px margins) at the top, 260-300px tall, tight leading. Under it a wide contained image (1392x430, radius 24) whose top 50px is overlapped by the wordmark (wordmark in front). Under the image, left, one 20px sentence (max 560px, three lines at most); right, a 64px high filled viewer bar with the work's title and a filled circle arrow button; the whole group ends 24px above the bottom edge. Pinned 120vh: over the first wheel steps the wordmark shrinks to 50%, centres and fades while the image frame expands to take over the screen. Colour roles: ground flat; wordmark ink or accent; image in full colour.
phone: Wordmark fitted to the width (about 120px tall) overlapping a 4:5 image by 40px; sentence 17px; viewer bar full width, 56px; shrink effect over 80vh.
houseRuleCheck: The stack ends 24px above the fold so nothing of the next section shows; the sentence is 20px. The wordmark over the image is type, not a box.

name: Full video with edge-to-edge bottom wordmark
description: Full-screen looping video (graded to one hue or natural; a flat ink layer at 20-35% if the footage is busy), 100svh, no boxes over it. Along the bottom a giant wordmark in live display type, fitted by script to 93-95% of the width (24-48px side margins at 1440), 265-310px tall, leading 0.8, tracking -0.03em, white or the accent, its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. A name too long for that height breaks into two stacked lines. Top row only: logo mark left or centred, two or three 18px links at the sides. No other copy, no button. On scroll the wordmark stays fixed while the video under it cross-fades through 2-3 clips over 200-300vh, then the section ends. Variant with a title: the footage is a slow macro texture (cloth, water, stone, smoke); bottom-left, 48px in, a two-line title of 56-66px (one face, the second line indented 120px) sits just above the giant word, which is then one italic serif word of the page's idea, letters about 280px tall, overlapping the title's last line by 40% of its cap height; one filled pill (56px high) at the right end of the title row; on scroll the texture scales up 12% and the giant word slides 80px left. Colour roles: ground = the footage; ink white; accent = the wordmark colour in the last clip, or the pill.
phone: Wordmark or giant word fitted to 92% width on one or two stacked lines (80-180px tall); portrait crop of the video; the title variant sets its title at 34px above the giant word with a full-width pill above the bottom edge; the top row collapses to logo plus a menu word.
houseRuleCheck: The giant word lives in the hero only: the footer never repeats it. At least 24px side margins, no letter touching an edge. No preloader window. In the title variant the title is one face throughout and the giant word is its own element, never a styled word inside the title.

name: Full-height film or stills, mid-left copy
description: A 100vh cover film bleeding to all edges under one flat 30% ink layer (no gradient); without footage, one art-directed still with a slow 1.06 to 1.0 scale settle, or 3-5 stills crossfading every 6s. A left-anchored block starting at x=140 (about 10%), vertically at 55%: a headline of 72px in two lines (white, leading 1.0, max 600px) and, 56px under it, one filled pill (56px high, white fill, ink label). The right half stays empty so the subject sits there. Bottom row, 40px up: centred a 48px filled circle with a down arrow; bottom-right a 56px filled pause circle (40px in), with slide dots beside it when stills play (10px filled circles, 14px gaps, the active one a 28px-wide pill). With several stills the headline changes with each one (lines rise out of masks, 60ms stagger). On scroll the media dims 40% and the block lifts out in 0.5s. Colour roles: ground = the footage or stills; ink white; accent = none or the pill's ink.
phone: Headline 38-46px bottom-left stack with a full-width pill under it; object-position keeps the subject above the text; dots centred above the pill; swipe advances stills; the down arrow dropped.
houseRuleCheck: One flat ink layer, never a gradient; buttons solid, never translucent. The open right half is for the subject. Pair it with distinctive, styled footage or photographs: it is the plainest media hero.

name: Slide loop with centre-line text row
description: Full-screen cover-fit slides (video or strong artwork), 5-7 of them, advancing by wheel, swipe, arrow keys or a 6-second timer; each next slide wipes in from the bottom (clip-path inset from 100% to 0, 0.9s, ease-in-out) under a flat 25% ink layer. Across the vertical centre line runs one horizontal row of three items inside 24px side margins: at the left edge a year or place in 20px sans, in the middle a one-line title of 40-64px (white, one line, centred), at the right edge the category in 20px sans. The row's texts slide up out of masks with each slide. Logo top-left and a menu button top-right, 32px in. No slide counter, no progress line. Colour roles: ground = the slide media; ink white; accent = the menu button fill or none.
phone: The row stacks into a centred title (30-36px) with year and category on one 16-18px line beneath it; vertical swipe advances; the timer pauses when the tab is hidden.
houseRuleCheck: No slide counter and no progress line; the year is a plain date.

name: Poster gate with bottom stack
description: A gate over a full-bleed key-art frame (the first frame of the intro film or a poster still, cover fit), 100svh, with at most a 20% flat ink layer. Header: the wordmark centred at 20-24px (white, normal tracking, in the display face), 32px from the top. All content stacks bottom-centre, 40px from the bottom: a three-line serif title (lines of 48px, 120px and 48px, whole phrases in one face, leading 0.95, the oversized line in the middle), 24px under it a small square-cornered button (48px high, 180px wide, filled white, ink label), and under that a language select as plain 16px text with a caret (two or three choices). The click starts the intro film: the poster crossfades to video, the title lifts away and the film hands over to the hero. Colour roles: ground = the poster; ink white; accent none.
phone: Same bottom stack: title 28/64/28px, button full width minus 48px, language select under it; wordmark top-centre at 18px.
houseRuleCheck: Wordmark at normal tracking and 20px or more. The large middle line is a whole phrase, never one picked-out word.

name: Black gate with actions at the foot
description: Entry screen on pure black, no nav, 100svh. Mid-screen a centred brand animation: a small mark in the upper third, or a looping logo video about 500px wide dead centre, and optionally one short 20px line under it. The choice sits apart at the screen foot, 56-100px up: two text actions side by side 28-36px apart, set in a serif at 28-36px (white; an underline grows from the left on hover), one for entering with sound and one without; or a single pill button 56px high. A 14px sentence-case caption sits under them. The click fades the mark first, then the black lifts to the hero. Colour roles: ground pure black, ink white, accent none. Use only where sound or a fly-in follows.
phone: Mark centred in the upper-middle; the two choices stack as two full-width 56px text rows near the bottom with 16px between; caption below.
houseRuleCheck: Plain pill or text actions, never a notched or ticket-shaped button. Caption 14px sentence case. Only where sound or a fly-in follows.

name: Compact centred gate on dark
description: An entry screen, 100svh, flat near-black (or a heavily dimmed, blurred still of the real hero at 80% ink). One compact stack centred on both axes with 15-32px between items: the brand's own mark (48-80px, a supplied file; if none, the first letter in the display face), a one- or two-line welcome of 28-40px (white, max 480px wide), and one button, a pill 56px high and 200-260px wide, filled light with an 18px label. The button shows a wait word while assets load and switches to the enter word when ready; the click fades the stack and lifts the gate (translateY -100%, 0.9s) to reveal the live hero and starts sound if the site has any. A 16px sentence-case skip link bottom centre, 32px up, enters without sound. Colour roles: ground near-black, ink white, accent = the button fill. Use only where the click does real work (sound, a fly-in).
phone: Same stack centred; welcome 24-30px; button full width minus 48px; skip link above the safe area.
houseRuleCheck: Only where the click does real work (sound, a fly-in). A legal line, if any, is 14px sentence case.

name: Giant-headline gate on flat colour
description: Entry gate on one flat saturated colour (not violet), 100svh, no photo ground. Small logo top centre (40px). A two-line giant condensed headline of about 14vw (200px at 1440), centred in the upper half, leading 0.85, near-black or cream, max 1300px wide. Under it a one-line 20px sub (24px gap) and one large full pill (64px high, 260px wide, filled dark with a light label) 40px below that; a 14px sentence-case policy line at the bottom. Four to six die-cut product photographs (transparent webp, 120-200px) float near the edges, each bobbing 8-14px on its own 4-6s loop and tilting 8 degrees on hover. The click lifts the screen away (translateY -100%, 0.8s) to the hero. Colour roles: ground flat saturated; ink near-black; accent = the pill fill if the ground is light.
phone: Headline 22vw in 2-3 lines (about 84px), sub 17px, full-width pill, only three floating cut-outs.
houseRuleCheck: Small print 14px sans in sentence case. The floating objects are photographed die-cut products, never drawn icons or stickers.

name: Lone cover-tile gate
description: Entry screen, 100svh, pure black with a 6% static grain; nothing but one small square cover image (230px, radius 0) dead centre: no nav, no text, no button. The tile breathes (scale 1.0 to 1.03, 4s loop). On hover or focus it lifts 6px and a small pill cursor label of 18px sentence case (a play word) follows the pointer; the tile has an accessible name and a keyboard focus ring in the accent. The click scales the cover to full screen (0.9s), starts the sound and opens the site beneath it. Colour roles: ground black; ink = the cover art itself; accent = the focus ring only.
phone: Tile 55% of the width with a visible tap-pill label 56px below it, since there is no hover.
houseRuleCheck: The cover is designed art (a record or poster cover), never an archive photograph. Only where the click starts sound or a film.

name: Title gate over darkened scene
description: Entry gate over a full-bleed image or live 3D scene dimmed by one flat ink layer at 45-55%, no nav, 100svh. A centred stack mid-screen: an optional small lockup (logo 40-56px) above; a title of 2-3 lines at 96-140px (white, leading 0.95; lines may alternate a sans and a serif but each line is set whole); a one-line sub of 20px 24px under it; one filled light pill, 56px high, 56px below the sub. The label rolls (vertical swap) from the wait word to the enter word when assets are ready; the click flies the camera into the scene (800ms dolly, title scaling to 1.3 and fading) and hands over to the live hero. Colour roles: ground = the darkened scene; ink white; accent = the button fill.
phone: Title 44-64px in three lines; sub 16-18px; button full width minus 48px; portrait crop of the scene.
houseRuleCheck: A filled pill only, never an outlined pill or rectangle. Each title line whole in one face.

name: Lone centred word with three-cell foot line
description: White or pale one-screen, 100svh, with 80px margins. A single bold word dead centre, 160-220px at 1440 (heavy grotesque, leading 0.9, near-black), the only display element; 40px under it one centred sentence of 24px (max 640px). A transparent nav row of three 18px links on top. Along the bottom, 80px up, one three-part row on one baseline at 18px: left a place and a date, centre a two-line sentence (max 300px, centred), right one filled pill (48px high) for the main action. Hover on the word: its weight eases from 800 to 600 over 0.4s (variable font) while a flat accent fill sweeps through the letters from left to right. Colour roles: ground white, ink near-black, accent = the sweep and the pill.
phone: Word fitted to 80% of the width on one line (two stacked if long), sentence under it at 18px; the foot row becomes two rows: place and date, then the full-width pill.
houseRuleCheck: No issue number, tiny caption, partner logo or icon row; the foot row is a place and date, one sentence and one pill.

name: Wordmark inside a two-screen video frame
description: The page ground shows as a 20px frame around a rounded frame (radius 12) holding a looping 3D video; the frame is two screens tall (200vh) and pinned while its content changes. Screen one, whole on its own: a custom-lettered wordmark in live display type spans 94% of the frame width at the top (about 200px tall) and a large object, the video's subject, rises from the bottom edge cropped by it. Screen two, after 100vh of scroll: a statement of 3-4 lines at 64-72px (white, first line indented 120px, leading 1.0) over the same video as the object drifts up and out, with one filled pill under it. Colour roles: ground = the page tone as the frame; video in one hue family; ink white; accent = the pill.
phone: Frame 10px, radius 16; wordmark fitted to the width (two stacked lines if needed); statement 32-38px in five lines with a 40px indent.
houseRuleCheck: No tag row or translucent plate; the statement is four lines at most. The first screen is complete alone; the second screen is the same pinned frame, not the next section.

name: Half photo with straddling title
description: A split 100svh below a 72px nav. The left 58%: one photograph (square corners or radius 16) filling the height from under the nav to 24px above the bottom edge, with a 12px flat accent bar down the left gutter beside it. A two-line title of 74px (leading 0.98, one face, a whole phrase) starts so its first letters overlap the photo's right edge by 80-140px: it is drawn twice, one copy clipped to the photo area in white and one clipped to the ground in ink, so the letters change colour exactly at the edge. Right of the photo, under the title: a 20px paragraph of up to three lines (max 380px) and one filled pill (56px high). Nothing else; no card over the photo. Hover on the pill: the photo scales 1.03 inside its frame. Colour roles: ground a pale warm tone, ink near-black, accent = the bar and the pill.
phone: Photo full width on top (52% of the height); the title, 40px, starts 24px from the left and overlaps the photo's bottom edge with the same two-copy clip; paragraph and pill below.
houseRuleCheck: No label, dash, side rule, tab strip or card over the photo. The title is one face, a whole phrase.

name: Headline-less 3D subject, corner items
description: A full-bleed canvas scene, 100svh, with one central subject (an object on terrain, or a cut-out portrait filling about 90% of the height) and no headline. Only small items sit in the four corners, each 32-48px from the edges: top-left the wordmark (24px), top-right a menu pill (44px high, filled), bottom-left a sound toggle (48px filled circle), bottom-right a two-line data block of 18px (a place and a date, or a price) with one shop pill (48px high). No card, no label. The subject moves by itself (a slow 8s loop of rotation or breathing) and answers scroll over 150vh by turning 40 degrees and dollying forward. Colour roles: ground = the scene (one hue family); ink white or black by luminance; accent = the pills.
phone: Subject centred at 60% of the height; wordmark and menu in the top row, data block and shop pill stacked bottom; the sound toggle moves to the top row.
houseRuleCheck: No card or outlined box over the scene; corner items are plain text and filled buttons. The wordmark is real type or the supplied logo.

name: Rounded photo frame beside side rail
description: Warm off-white ground with a fixed side rail 120px wide at the left: wordmark at the top, three nav words stacked in 16px medium sans in the middle, a small filled round menu button at the bottom. To its right a single photo frame fills the rest of the screen, 24px from the rail, the top, the right edge and the bottom (about 1270x852 at 1440x900), radius 36px, entirely inside the first screen. Centred inside the frame: a 72px two-line heavy sans headline in white, a two-line 20px sub and one dark filled pill button (56px tall) with an arrow glyph at its right end. The photo carries a flat 25% dark tint for the text. On load the frame opens from the centre to full size (clip-path inset, 0.9s) and the headline rises through a mask. Colour roles: ground off-white, ink near-black, the pill is the single accent. On scroll the rail stays fixed and the photo drifts at 0.9 speed inside the frame.
phone: The rail becomes a 64px top bar (wordmark left, round menu button right); the frame is inset 12px with radius 24px and fills the rest of the screen; headline 40px, pill at the bottom of the frame.
houseRuleCheck: No chips floating on the photo; colour is ground, ink and one accent on the pill.

name: Inset rounded video, giant bottom-left type
description: The page ground (a pale tint or near-black) shows as a 12px frame around a rounded video (radius 20) that fills the first screen (100svh minus 24px). A floating nav sits inside the frame at the top (logo left; three 18px links and a filled pill right; 24px in). Anchored bottom-left, 40px in and 40px up: a giant headline of 114-168px, 1-3 lines, white, leading 0.9, one face, max 1000px wide; bottom-right one filled pill (56px high) or a two-line 18px sentence. One flat 25% ink layer keeps it legible. On scroll the video scales to 0.92 and its radius grows to 32 while it dims 30%, the headline staying pinned for the first 60vh. Colour roles: ground = the page tone as the frame; ink white; accent = the pill.
phone: Frame 8px, radius 20; headline 52-68px bottom-left in three lines with a full-width pill under it; nav collapses to logo plus a menu pill.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the headline and no teaser card on the video.

name: Intro column left, headline and window right
description: Light warm-grey ground with fine grain on a 12-column grid, 64px margins, filling exactly one screen. Columns 1 to 4: wordmark at the top, a short intro in 22px regular (three lines at most) and, sticky at the bottom of the column, one solid black round arrow button so the column never sits empty. Columns 5 to 12: a 132px four-line headline (medium sans, leading 0.95, one face throughout) starting at the top, and beneath it a photo window 8 columns wide (~900x600, radius 6px) of which the top ~280px sits inside the first screen. As the page scrolls the window rises into full view while the photo inside moves at 0.8 speed (parallax inside the mask); nothing else shows below it. Menu link top right. Colour roles: ground warm grey, ink near-black, photo carries the rest.
phone: Single column: wordmark, 44px headline, 18px intro, then the photo window full width at 4:5 with parallax inside; the round button sticks bottom right.
houseRuleCheck: No bracketed tag, ghost mark or translucent layer; text is 22px or more except the navigation. The left column always holds the button so it never sits empty.

name: Justified statement across full width
description: White ground, one full screen, 40px margins (content width about 1360 at 1440). Top row: wordmark left and an optional local time and city at the right in 18px sentence case. Centre of the screen: a four-line upper-case statement set at 64px with a 70px line pitch, every line justified to the full 1360 width, the words alternating strictly one by one between a thin serif and a heavy grotesque so that no single word reads as the accent. Beneath it a two-line 22px justified tagline over the same width and one solid black pill button centred. Ink black on white; the button carries the one accent colour. On load the statement rises word by word; on scroll the block holds and tightens.
phone: Statement becomes eight justified lines at 30px with hyphenation on and the same word-by-word alternation; tagline left-aligned in 3 lines; button full width.
houseRuleCheck: Faces alternate on every word, never on a single word. No name line, bracket or dot above the statement; the clock row is 18px sentence case. The hero fills the screen alone.

name: Left lockup over 3D landscape
description: A fixed full-viewport WebGL landscape (terrain, a low sun and a cloud deck in two or three tones: ground and horizon in one hue, light in one accent) is the page ground. The hero shows only a logo lockup about 500px wide, left of centre (starting near x 240) at mid-height: the mark at 72px, a 24px gap, then a light-weight wordmark at 44px with wide tracking. Navigation sits on top as plain text links, and a short 16px sentence-case scroll hint is the only other element at the bottom. Over about 720px of scroll the camera sinks down into the cloud layer, the landscape tints toward the next section's ground colour and the lockup fades out. The first screen holds the lockup and the navigation only.
phone: Lockup centred at 60% width at 40% height, camera path runs vertically; navigation collapses into a round menu button; the hint sits bottom centre.
houseRuleCheck: No divider rule in the lockup; the hint is 16px sentence case. The first screen is the hero alone; the next section arrives only after the camera descent.

name: Left giant logotype, round start button
description: Near-black full-screen 3D interior (a hall or room in WebGL with a few warm light points). Colour roles: ground near-black, ink off-white, one warm accent on the start button. An emblem is centred at the top (48px); sound and language toggles sit at the top right, 48px from the edges. A left block starts at x 96 and is vertically centred: one 56px condensed line in sentence case that reads as the first line of the headline set, a giant condensed logotype at about 320px, and under it a 20px one-line subtitle with normal tracking. A 120px circular start button with a slow pulse sits bottom right, 64px from the edges. Pressing it flies the camera into the hall while the left block lifts away; the stage is pinned for about 1.5 screens.
phone: Logotype 120px stacked on two lines at the 24px left margin, the 56px line becomes 28px, start button 96px bottom centre, camera starts a little lower.
houseRuleCheck: The 56px line is the first line of the headline, never a label above it; the subtitle has normal tracking.

name: Centre-line row loader
description: A load screen on a flat light-grey ground (ink near-black, one accent in the lockup). A single horizontal row sits on the vertical centre across the width with 64px margins: the lockup (mark plus wordmark, 40px) at the left, a one-line tagline of at most five words at the centre in 24px, and at the right a status word in 24px that swaps through two or three states while loading (no number, no counter). A sound hint at the bottom right, 40px from the edges, in 16px sentence case. On completion the tagline and status fade, the lockup rises to the top-left and becomes the page wordmark, and two cover layers (first the grey, then a second tone) fade off in turn to show the hero canvas, which then fills the screen alone.
phone: The row turns into a vertical stack centred on the screen (lockup, tagline, status word); the sound hint sits bottom centre.
houseRuleCheck: Status words, never a number or counter; 64px margins on the row; the hint 40px in.

name: Centred mark loader on dark
description: Loader screen, 100svh, flat black or near-black with no texture: one small mark or lockup centred (40-250px wide, white). Optionally a one- or two-line status of 16-18px sentence case under it (24px gap) that cycles through random glyphs for about 700ms before settling on its words, set in the page's own sans. Total hold 1.2-1.8s, never longer than the real load. Hand-over: the screen slides up in a clean wipe (or the mark scales to 40x and the field cuts away) into the hero, whose own entrance starts as the wipe passes. Colour roles: ground near-black, ink white, accent none.
phone: Same, mark 56-96px, status 15px.
houseRuleCheck: No drawn arcs or texture; the glyph scramble is set in the page's sans. Never hold longer than the real load; skip on repeat visits.

name: 3D object loader with rolling word
description: A load screen on an off-white canvas with fine grain (ground off-white, ink near-black, accent only inside the 3D object). One tilted glossy 3D object about 420px tall (a product or a brand form built in WebGL from simple primitives) sits dead centre and rises into place with a slight turn. Beside its upper-left corner a 72px serif window clipped to one line of height rolls vertically like an odometer through three short words (a verb, an adjective, the brand promise), one every 0.7s, and settles on the last word as the object lands. When done the object scales into its hero position (it becomes the hero object) and the grain canvas stays as the hero ground, so the hero fills the first screen alone.
phone: Object at 60% of the width centred, the rolling word window above it centred, nothing else.
houseRuleCheck: Rolling words, never digits; no captions hugging the edges and no status bar.

name: Pixel-cell photo reveal under giant title
description: A loader that is the hero's opening: a fixed full-screen art-directed photo (never documentary) covered at first by a grid of near-black square cells (about 24 columns by 14 rows at 1440, each ~60px). Cells drop out in order of distance from the bottom centre, opening a blocky window into the photo; as progress advances a few cells re-cover and open again so the window grows in steps. Over it, a centred two-line title at 138px in an oblique heavy upper-case face. The title fill is a hard-edged wipe: it starts as a 20% tint of white and a solid white fill sweeps up from the baseline with a crisp edge in step with the load progress. When loaded the remaining cells clear and the title settles. Ground near-black, ink white, no accent.
phone: 12 columns by 20 rows of cells, title 64px on two lines, same bottom-centre origin.
houseRuleCheck: The title fills with a hard-edged solid wipe, never a gradient; no counter. The cells are a mask that clears fully, not boxes on the photo. Art-directed photograph only.

name: Rotating type ring loader
description: A load screen on one flat saturated colour (ground a brand colour, ink contrasting). A single ring of condensed capitals, letters about 64px tall set on a circle about 600px across, centred, rotates slowly (one turn per 12 seconds) and breathes in scale by 4%. Inside it sits one short word at 72px that swaps through three states. Progress is shown by the ring's letters filling from a 20% tint to full ink, clockwise; there is no number. When loading finishes the ring expands past the screen as its letters spread apart, and the ground colour cross-fades to the hero ground; the hero then fills the screen alone. Nothing else on screen.
phone: Ring 300px across with 28px letters, inner word 36px.
houseRuleCheck: No number: progress shows only as the letters filling and the inner word changing.

name: Logotype band over scattered stills and search
description: One screen split into two bands. Top band (about 38% of the height, white ground): a logotype 450px wide at the left (x 64) and at the right a three-line 22px tagline over one solid black pill button, the only accent. Lower band (a flat pale-tint ground with no rules or grid): nine rounded stills (radius 14, widths 120 to 260, mixed portrait and landscape) scattered across the width inside 48px margins, one slightly larger near the left, plus an 800px-wide filled white search pill, 64px tall and fully rounded, centred low in the band. A typed query inside the pill cycles through three phrases and with each phrase the stills swap to match with a quick staggered crossfade. Stills are art-directed or product pictures, never documentary.
phone: Top band holds the logotype at 60% width and the button; the lower band shows six stills in two columns and the search pill at full width near the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: No ruled or graph-paper ground and no translucent dock; every still inside the 48px margins; art-directed or product pictures only.

name: Masked 3D island with start prompt
description: Full-bleed WebGL world, first screen only, on a near-black ground. A shader mask uncovers a single disc-shaped island (about 555x300 on screen at 1440, an ellipse in perspective, with a crisp lit rim in one accent hue) at the centre; inside it a small diorama of a few lit modelled forms idles with a slow turn. The floor outside the island is a field of dim dots in perspective (no lines). On load the island opens from a point, the camera eases back and up, and a three-word start prompt in a brush-lettered display face (72px) fades up beneath it. A click or key press starts the experience and the island expands to fill the view. Only a menu button top right and a sound toggle share the screen.
phone: Island 80% of the width, prompt 48px, tap to start, same camera ease.
houseRuleCheck: The floor is dots, never grid lines; the rim is a crisp lit edge, no glow. The prompt is a lettered typeface, not a drawn picture.

name: Offset 3D logo in ring relief
description: A full-viewport canvas rendered in three tones of one hue (ground mid-tone, ridges light, troughs dark, no second colour), shaded in hard bands (toon shading) so each tone is flat and no smooth ramp shows. Embossed rounded-square bands radiate outward from a soft blob that holds a 3D rendition of the brand mark. The blob sits off-centre at about 75% across and 74% down, so the left half of the screen is open ring field; the bands widen toward the edges and ripple slowly, and the pointer pushes a soft wave through them while the mark tilts with it. One filled pill button (18px text) at the bottom centre, wordmark top left and menu top right at 48px margins. No headline: the mark is the hero.
phone: Mark placed at 60% down and centred, bands tighter, pill at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Shading banded into three flat tones, never a smooth ramp; the relief is a lit render, not outlined lines or drawn shapes.

name: Title crossing the fold over photo
description: A full-bleed tall art-directed photo (about two screens high, subject in the right 55%) scrolls at half speed under a flat 20% dark tint. The first screen: a text column at x 120 starting near 38% height holds a two-line 22px sub and below it a 250px two-line heavy sans title in white, laid out so the second line is deliberately cut by the fold and only its upper 60% is visible on load; scrolling brings it fully into view as the photo slides on. Wordmark top left, menu top right. A solid 84px round button at the bottom right, 48px inside the edges, with a two-word hint in 18px sentence case beside it. Nothing from another section shows in the first screen.
phone: Title 84px on two lines with the second line cut by the fold, the round button bottom right with its margin kept.
houseRuleCheck: The round button is solid with a 48px margin. The title's crop at the fold is intended; nothing of the next section shows.

name: Wordmark band over centred round object
description: A near-black one-screen cover, 20px margins on a phone and 48px at 1440. Top: a stencil-cut wordmark spanning the full content width (about 1344 wide and 170px tall at 1440) in off-white. Middle: one round object centred in the free height, 349px on a phone and about 520px at 1440, a rendered or photographed disc form (a record, a dial, a coin or a lens, whichever belongs to the brand), lit from one side and rotating slowly. Bottom: a one-line 18px credit text with two underlined links and a muted 14px note beneath it. Colour roles: ground near-black, ink off-white, one accent on the links. On load the wordmark rises through a mask and the object turns up from the dark.
phone: This is the phone layout: wordmark band at the top, the 349px object centred in the free height, the credit line and note at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The centrepiece is a rendered or photographed round object, never a drawn dial with rings, ticks or numerals.

name: Wordmark band over filled fact rows
description: A one-screen cover, 20px margins on a phone and 48px at 1440. Top: a heavy wordmark lockup spanning the full width with a solid accent bar (24px tall) directly beneath it. A large open field of flat ground follows. Anchored to the bottom: three filled rows (each 64px tall, a pale tint one step off the ground, 8px gaps, radius 10), every row a two-column pair with a 16px label in the left column and a 20px value in the right column (role, place, year or other plain facts), then a three-line 36px headline row with a short scroll hint in the left column. Colour roles: ground near-white or near-black, rows one step off the ground, one accent bar. The rows reveal bottom-up with a 60ms stagger.
phone: This is the phone layout; the rows stay full width and the headline drops to 28px.
houseRuleCheck: Filled rows with gaps, never rules; three rows at most so it never becomes a credit wall; labels 16px sentence case, never tiny capitals.

name: Photo with left copy and right quote
description: A full-bleed art-directed photo under a flat 35% dark tint. Two balanced blocks share the middle band, both vertically centred: the left block at x 90 holds a 40px two-line sans headline, a two-line 20px sub and one white filled button; the right block (about 460 wide, its right edge 90px from the screen edge) is one quote set directly on the photo in 28px light with the speaker's name and role beneath in 18px, with no box. A short scroll word with a small arrow is centred at the bottom. On load the headline lines rise through masks and the quote fades in 0.4s later; on scroll the blocks drift apart by 40px while the photo scales slowly. Ink white, no accent beyond the button.
phone: Left block only; the quote sits under it at 20px, or is dropped when the photo is busy.
houseRuleCheck: The quote sits on the photo as plain type, no panel; no small tag; nothing above the navigation.

name: Render with figures band, halftone dissolve
description: A full-bleed 3D render or product photo pinned for about two screens of scroll under a flat 30% dark tint. Top band at 48px margins: wordmark at the left and at the right two figure pairs, each a 56px number with an 18px sentence-case caption below (static numbers that do not count up). Lower left: a 40px three-line upper-case serif statement. A solid 176px round button lower right with an arrow and two words. On scroll the wordmark and figures slide up out, the render zooms to 1.15 and dissolves into a halftone-dot ground in the next section's colour through a shader, the dots growing as the picture dissolves, while the statement holds until the end. Ink white over the render; one accent on the round button.
phone: Figures in a two-up row under the wordmark, statement 28px, button 120px, same dissolve.
houseRuleCheck: Static figures, never counting up; no small label or meta row; a flat tint, no gradient.

name: Image sequence shrinking into a card
description: Pinned for about 1.5 screens: a canvas image sequence (60 to 120 frames) of one product rotating fills the screen on a soft studio ground (flat light grey that lightens to near-white by colour transition as you scroll, no gradient). Bottom left at 64px margins: a 60px two-line sans headline, a one-line 20px sub and two pill buttons (one filled in the accent, one a tinted fill). On scroll the copy fades, the product turns a quarter turn as the ground lightens, then the full-screen canvas shrinks into a framed card (about 960x560, radius 28, filled ground) centred on the screen and the next scene begins around it. Colour roles: ground studio grey, ink near-black, accent only on the filled pill.
phone: Portrait sequence, headline 36px, pills stacked, the card 90% of the width.
houseRuleCheck: No kicker or labelled thumbnail; the ground changes as a flat colour, and the final card is filled, never outlined.

name: Title relay over wiping videos
description: A pinned stage of about three screens of scroll with three or four full-bleed videos stacked; each slides up from below in turn and wipes the previous one. The active title sits top-left at x 64 in 150px bold caps (white, 0.9 leading) and the waiting titles stack right-aligned beneath it at 64px in 55% white, ending 64px inside the right edge. On each swap the next title grows from its queue position into the top-left slot while the old one shrinks away to the right and exits, and the queue re-forms. A small filled round arrow button sits bottom right, 48px inside the edges. Flat 25% dark tint over the video; ink white, no accent.
phone: Active title 64px top left, waiting titles 28px stacked beneath and right-aligned, videos wipe the same way.
houseRuleCheck: The queue sits 64px inside the right edge; no small labels or counters.

name: Round demo window with headline column
description: A dark full-screen canvas (ground near-black, ink off-white, one accent for the disc and the button). A round demo window about 640px across, centred at x ~960 so the left column keeps room, holds a looping product demo clipped to a circle and sits on a solid accent disc 48px wider than the window (no tick marks, segments or rings). Left column at x 64: a 64px three-line headline, a two-line 20px sub, then a code chip (the install or run command set as code, the one place a code face belongs) and one filled button. Bottom right: a one-line 18px sentence-case fact. The stage is pinned for about one screen: on scroll the accent disc scales away while the demo window grows to fill the screen.
phone: Headline at the top at 40px, the 300px window on its disc beneath it, then the code chip and the button.
houseRuleCheck: The window sits on a solid accent disc: no tick marks, segments or rings; the button is filled; code type only in the command chip.

name: Scrubbed film with typed statements
description: A pinned stage 400-500vh tall on a flat near-black ground. A full-viewport canvas (cover fit) draws a frame sequence of 120-240 webp frames at 1920 wide, or a film whose currentTime is mapped to scroll progress. One centred statement sits on the stage: 56-82px at 1440, 2-4 lines of about 24-30 characters, white, leading 1.05, a single face. Each statement builds in place, character by character behind a 2px ink caret or word by word, over about 600px of scroll, then the next statement (two or three in all) replaces it; the block keeps its bottom line fixed so the text grows upward. Nav is minimal and transparent. No button until the last statement, which may carry one filled pill. When the pin ends the stage unpins and slides up at half speed beneath the next section, which covers it. Colour roles: ground near-black, ink white, accent only on that final button.
phone: Portrait crop of the frame sequence (or a second 9:16 set); statements 30-40px in up to five short lines; pin shortened to 300vh; with reduced motion show the last frame and the whole statement at once.
houseRuleCheck: Three statements at most, each short. The caret is a plain 2px bar. No button before the last statement.

name: Shaped window cut in a flat plane
description: A full-screen plane of one flat colour (white, or a single brand colour; ink contrasting) laid over a fixed canvas of looping footage or photographs. In the plane a hole about 650px across, centred: soft-edged in the shape of the brand mark, or a crisp plain hexagon (about 690x580). Through it shows a collage of three or four footage clips, or one photograph. Bottom left at 48px margins a 24px bold two-line tagline in sentence case; bottom right a short scroll hint with an arrow; wordmark top left and menu top right. Variant with words: three bold 72px words in white set across the window, the third cycling every 2.2s through four words, each with its own photo cutting in inside the window; all three words in one style. On load the hole grows from a dot to full size (0.9s); the pointer ripples a soft-edged hole gently; scroll widens the hole until the footage or photo fills the screen and the next scene replaces the plane.
phone: Hole 90% of the width (a tall hexagon in that variant), tagline or words beneath at 20-44px, corner items reduced to the wordmark and the menu; scroll widens it the same way.
houseRuleCheck: Tagline in sentence case. The hole is a mask of the mark or a plain polygon, never loose drawn blobs. The cycling word keeps the same style as the other words. Colour is the plane, ink and the pictures.

name: Type-only hero with left headline
description: A full-screen type-only hero with no media. Ground a light warm tint, ink near-black, one accent used only on the button. The headline sits at the left margin (x 64) across about 55% of the width, anchored in the upper part of the screen: 144px light-weight sans in two lines with tight negative tracking (-0.04em), one face throughout and no accent word. Anchored bottom left: a 28px muted three-line sub and one filled pill button. The right 45% is deliberately open ground. On load the lines rise through masks, then the sub fades in; on scroll the headline slides 80px left and fades.
phone: Headline 56px, sub 18px, button full width at the bottom, same open space above the sub.
houseRuleCheck: One face throughout, no accent word, no badges or plus marks; a full screen, the open right side intended.

name: Copy left, overlapping app and phone right
description: Full screen on a light tint ground with 64px margins; nothing from the next section shows. Left column (x 64, about 5 of 12 columns) vertically centred: a 40px three-line headline, a two-line 20px grey sub and one large filled button 64px tall. Right half: an app window (about 700x435, radius 14, a filled panel showing a real product screen) with a phone frame (about 220x440) overlapping its lower-right corner by about a quarter. The pair sits 64px inside the right edge and 64px above the bottom, never cropped by an edge. On load the window slides in from the right and the phone rises 0.2s later; on scroll they drift upward at different speeds (window 30px, phone 60px). Colour roles: ground off-white, ink near-black, accent on the button and inside the product screens only.
phone: Copy first, the app window beneath it at full width, the phone overlapping its bottom-right corner at 28% of the width.
houseRuleCheck: A full screen, nothing of the next section; the window and the phone stay 64px inside the edges, never cropped.

name: Type half beside colour strips, panning
description: A hard 50/50 split pinned for about two screens of scroll. Left half on a light ground: three text links at the top, the giant condensed wordmark art centred (about 480px wide at 1440) with a two-line 22px tagline beneath, and a short row of social text links at the foot. Right half: three full-height filled strips with a 24px outer margin and 12px gaps, widths in the ratio 7:2:1, each a tonal step of one hue (deep, mid, light), each holding one photo placed at a different height (top, middle, bottom) so the row reads staggered. On scroll the left half slides out to the left and the strips pan sideways and open into project panels, each a large photo with a short title, driven by scroll alone (no drag, no progress bar).
phone: The wordmark on top, the three strips as three horizontal bands beneath it; on scroll they pan vertically into the project panels.
houseRuleCheck: Strips inset 24px; no panel numbers or progress bar; scroll alone pans, never a drag; tonal steps of one hue.

name: Spread display line over fact cards
description: One screen on a dark ground, 64px margins, 8-column grid. A single 200px display line of four words (heavy condensed sans, upper case) is spread so the first word starts at the left margin, the last word ends at the right margin and the middle words are spaced evenly between, set at about 36% of the height. 48px below it a row of three filled cards (each about 420x220, radius 16, one step lighter than the ground) with very little text: card one a sentence of at most 20 words, card two a list of three plain words, card three a filled accent card with one action word and an arrow. On load the four words slide in from their own sides to rest and the cards rise with a stagger; on scroll the line stays pinned while the cards slide up. Ink off-white, accent on card three only.
phone: The line breaks into two rows of two words at 72px, the three cards stack in single file.
houseRuleCheck: No rule, bracket label, numbers or small code type; three filled cards only, never a box inside a box.

name: Stanza over fogged cut-out
description: A fixed canvas: a painted cut-out object (watercolour or gouache raster, about 715px tall, slightly right of centre) stands on a fog-grey ground (ground light grey, ink near-black, the painting's own colours). A flat white translucent fog covers it except where a soft circular lens of about 260px follows the cursor and shows the object in full colour. At the left, a stanza of six short lines at 32px in a light serif at x 120, the last two lines stepping down in opacity (60% and 30%), with a small underlined text hint beneath. Pinned for about three screens of scroll: every ~300px the stanza crossfades to the next one and the lens widens by 20px, finishing with the fog fully lifted. Only the wordmark and the menu share the screen.
phone: Stanza 24px at the top, the object beneath; the lens drifts by itself on a slow figure-of-eight instead of following a pointer.
houseRuleCheck: Stepped opacity, never a fading mask; the fog is a flat veil; six short lines at most.

name: Stepped three-line title over parallax picture
description: A full-screen WebGL picture plane (an art-directed photograph, or a painterly raster portrait) with fine grain and gentle pointer parallax (the plane shifts about 12px while the grain stays fixed) under a flat 20% dark tint. There is no bar across the top. A three-line heavy sans headline in white, 150-168px, leading 0.9, sits at the left with its lines stepped one of two ways: a uniform staircase, each line 70px further in than the one before (x 64, 134, 204), or an irregular zig-zag (line 1 at x 120, line 2 jumping right to x 640, line 3 back to x 64). A two-line 22px sub with an underlined link, or one filled button, sits at the lower right, 64px from the right edge and the bottom; a short scroll word sits at the bottom left. On load each line rises through a mask 0.12s after the previous (0.5s apart for the zig-zag, while the picture un-blurs); on scroll the lines step further apart (the zig-zag lines slide in opposite directions) while the picture scales to 1.05.
phone: Headline 56px with 24px steps, sub or button beneath it, a portrait cropped to the face, scroll parallax instead of pointer parallax.
houseRuleCheck: No bar across the top, no line frame, no line indexes and no loader; the sub is two lines at most. A portrait is a raster painting or photograph, never a vector drawing or a documentary photo.

name: Letters stretched to fill the width
description: A solid ground (one saturated brand colour, ink contrasting), hero about 1.45 screens tall. A two-line display title whose letters are stretched horizontally and vertically so each line spans the full content width of 1344px: line 1 about 580px tall (a condensed grotesque scaled non-uniformly into tall slabs), line 2 about 150px tall, a 24px gap between. A one- or two-line 18px serif caption at the top right. At load, six to eight cut-out pictures (rendered or photographic cut-outs, 120 to 240px) fly forward from the vanishing point past the viewer and fade as the type settles. As the page scrolls past the first screen the next scene slides over the hero. The first screen shows both lines whole.
phone: Three stacked lines each stretched to the full width, the first about 40% of the height, cut-outs reduced to four.
houseRuleCheck: The flying pictures are raster cut-outs, never drawn sketches; the stretch is a type transform, not a drawn shape.

name: Stretched name with wedged text
description: A full-screen art-directed still under a flat 55% black tint, layered over a live canvas with a slow noise ripple. A centred column about 830px wide holds three upper-case name lines in a vertically stretched condensed Didone (about 1.5x tall), each ~170px tall. Line 2 is pushed to the right by a two-line 22px title set directly in the gap to its left, with no box; line 3 has a filled button wedged into the gap to its right. Small corner items are a wordmark top left and a menu top right, in 16px sentence case. Ink off-white, accent only on the button. On load the lines rise through masks one after another; on scroll the column stays while the canvas ripple speeds up.
phone: Name lines at 64px, the wedged title and the button stack under the line they belong to.
houseRuleCheck: Corner items 16px sentence case; a flat tint only. The wedged title is plain type, no box.

name: Dealt photo arc over label dial
description: A light ground (off-white, ink near-black, no accent) that plays on load. Five portrait photo cards (each about 230x320, radius 16, art-directed pictures) are dealt one by one onto an upward arc across the upper half of the screen, 220px apart and tilted outward along the arc (-12, -6, 0, +6, +12 degrees), staggered 150ms from the centre card outward. Below them sits the top third of a very large dial (centre below the fold, zoomed from its pivot) carried by type only: five category labels at 56px bold sans set along the arc, with no drawn rim. Every two seconds the dial turns one step so the next label comes to the top and the photo above it lifts and rises to full opacity while the others rest at 70%. No headline block; the labels are the headline. Hover pauses the dial.
phone: Three cards on the arc, labels 36px, the dial turns on its own timer.
houseRuleCheck: The dial exists only as type on an arc: no drawn circle, rule or outline.

name: Two tilted sticker words
description: A bare solid ground (one brand colour, ink contrasting). Two giant condensed heavy words in caps, each about 430px tall, with a thick solid white die-cut halo (a 14px offset fill behind the letters): word one upright at the upper left (x 72); word two tilted about -8 degrees at the right with its right edge 72px from the screen edge; the two roughly 350px apart. The lower half is open except for a small 20px paragraph in each bottom corner, 48px from the edges. On load the words fade up and settle (scale 1.06 to 1, rotation easing in over 0.8s); on hover the tilted word wiggles by 2 degrees.
phone: The words stack, 190px tall, the second tilted, the two paragraphs stacked at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: The tilted word stays 72px inside the edge and nothing is cropped; the halo is a solid fill, not a thin outline.

name: Metal wordmark over centred headline and prints
description: A solid warm-grey ground (ink near-black, one accent on a button). A polished-metal 3D wordmark (rendered in WebGL or placed as a rendered picture) spans the full content width at the top, about 1300px wide and 200px tall, with a row of four text links centred beneath it. A tilted portrait print (a photo card about 220x300 rotated 6 degrees on a filled white mount) hangs at the right at about 70% across, and a second smaller print drifts at the lower left. A centred 63px three-line serif headline sits in the lower half with a one-line 20px sub and two square filled buttons (one dark, one light) beneath. On scroll the prints fly toward the camera and out of the frame in different directions while the wordmark tilts back.
phone: Wordmark at full width, the four links folded into a menu button, one print, headline 40px.
houseRuleCheck: No floating icons; the prints are photographs on mounts.

name: Video with text in grid zones
description: A full-bleed dark looping video under a flat 30% tint. All text sits on a 3-column grid with 32px margins in three rows. Top row: a 20px bold name in column 1, a stack of two or three text links in column 3 and a round filled menu icon at the far right. Middle row (vertically centred): a 62px two-line headline at the left across columns 1 and 2, and a three-line 16px sentence-case caption in column 3. Bottom row: a sound toggle at the left and one text link in column 3. No buttons, boxes or rules. Ink white, no accent. On load the top row fades first, the headline rises line by line, the caption arrives last.
phone: Columns collapse to one: name and menu at the top, the headline in the middle, caption and link at the bottom.
houseRuleCheck: Small text 16px sentence case; no buttons, boxes or rules; the top row holds only the name, the links and the menu, never a sentence.

name: Video with stacked chapter words
description: A full-screen dark looping video under a flat 30% tint. Text links sit in the top corners; a wordmark graphic about 400px wide is centred at the top with a small round filled toggle beneath it. In the lower centre, set in a difference blend so it reads on any frame, five 50px one-word chapter links stack on a 44px pitch, centred, ending 32px above the bottom. Hovering a word dims the others to 40% and swaps the video to that chapter's clip; clicking scrolls to the chapter. A pause glyph at the bottom left and a short 16px sentence-case scroll hint at the bottom right, both 32px from the edges. Ink white by difference; no accent.
phone: Words at 36px on a 40px pitch, toggle at the top, corner links folded into the menu.
houseRuleCheck: No label above the list; the words are navigation targets, never numbered; all type is the page's sans.
